question: Should plugin approval cancellation be accepted as a public `plugin.approval.cancel` RPC plus nullable `plugin.approval.resolved` event contract, or should the fix use a different internal/structured cancellation shape before merge?
rationale: The diff changes plugin SDK and gateway protocol behavior that third-party plugins and channel consumers can observe, so automation cannot safely decide the permanent API contract by itself.

options.title: Accept nullable cancellation contract
options.body: Land this direction after sibling waiters, docs/tests, and proof make cancellation consistent across plugin approval requesters.

options.title: Keep cancellation internal
options.body: Require a different implementation that cleans gateway state without exposing nullable resolved events as a plugin-facing contract.

options.title: Pause until protocol design
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers define a structured cancellation status or protocol versioning plan.

recommendation.title: Accept nullable cancellation contract
recommendation.body: Land this direction after sibling waiters, docs/tests, and proof make cancellation consistent across plugin approval requesters.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged and hardened the original plugin approval gateway/API surface that this PR expands.
